scripts.compile: npm run build -w @spec-driven-methodology/core && npm run build -w @spec-driven-methodology/cli && npm run build -w @spec-driven-methodology/mcp && npm run completion:install
scripts.build: node scripts/bump-version.mjs auto && npm run compile
scripts.link:cli: npm run build && npm link -w @spec-driven-methodology/cli && npm link -w @spec-driven-methodology/mcp && node packages/cli/dist/index.js completion install
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @spec-driven-methodology/core && npm run typecheck -w @spec-driven-methodology/cli && npm run typecheck -w @spec-driven-methodology/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @spec-driven-methodology/core && npm run test -w @spec-driven-methodology/cli && npm run test -w @spec-driven-methodology/mcp && npm run test:scripts
scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run compile && npm run typecheck && npm test
